name: GX700
summary: Higher-spec domestic complete with GRX 1×12, carbon cockpit and seatpost, plus an official 45C stock tire; the maximum clearance is not stated.

frame.construction: Fully internally routed thru-axle carbon gravel frame with carbon fork; exact lay-up and molding process are not published
frame.stiffness_evidence: No meaningful independent exact-model stiffness or deflection evidence was found; manufacturer strength wording is not treated as stiffness evidence
frame.geometry_status: No attributable numeric exact-model geometry table found after 50 registered source areas. The current page lists 700C×450/480/510 mm sizes only; its linked size.avif chart returned 403 on 2026-09-24, so geometry remains unknown. The 1×12 page's 26–36T crank row is a separate build-detail conflict.
frame.claimed_frame_weight_status: No frame-only mass found after 50 registered source areas; the approximately 10.2 kg figure is for the small complete bike without pedals and small accessories
frame.bottom_bracket_status: No exact shell or installed bottom-bracket standard found after 50 registered source areas; the exact GX700 page rechecked on 2026-09-24 still omits it. No standard is inferred from the FC-RX610 crank.

tire_clearance.note: The official complete comes with a 700×45C tire, proving that nominal width fits; the manufacturer does not state whether a larger tire fits.
